summary: Add usdb-node top for independent Docker and systemd process observations
details: Display process state, host PID, uptime, restarts, exit evidence and observed memory without requiring startup resource or RPC checks.
Support one-shot text, --watch, --json and --all; preserve independent observations when Docker or systemd queries fail.
Distinguish absent containers, disabled configuration and unavailable observations; never start or repair services.
operator_actions: Use usdb-node top with an updated node tool package to inspect processes even when ordinary status is blocked.
